label: rem:x5-z5-automorphism-interpretation
title: Lagrange-resolvent interpretation of $\phi_5$
html: Under the identification of x with the first Lagrange resolvent w_1 (Remark rem:lagrange-resolvents), the automorphism \phi_5 is the diagonalised action of the cyclic generator \sigma on w_1 via \phi_5 \leftrightarrow \sigma with \sigma(w_1) = \zeta_5^{-1} w_1. The orbit \{x, \zeta_5 x, \zeta_5^{2} x, \zeta_5^{3} x, \zeta_5^{4} x\} forms a single \mathbb{Z}_5-orbit of size five, matching the five finite branch points of the double cover.
